theory_fragments.content: An **experiment** is any procedure that can be infinitely repeated with a well-defined set of possible outcomes.
**Deterministic Experiments:** The outcome is exactly predictable if initial conditions are known.
s = ut + \frac{1}{2}gt^2
**Random (Stochastic) Experiments:** Exact outcome cannot be predicted with certainty, even under identical conditions (e.g., tossing a coin).
The first step in analyzing a random experiment is listing everything that could possibly happen.
**Sample Space ($S$ or $\Omega$):** The set of all possible outcomes of a random experiment.
Consider tossing a coin three times. We can visualize the sequential outcomes using a **Tree Diagram**.
S = \{HHH, HHT, HTH, HTT, THH, THT, TTH, TTT\}
When dealing with pairs of independent events (like rolling two dice), a **Grid Diagram** is the optimal visualization tool.
Die 1 forms the x-axis ($1$ through $6$).
Die 2 forms the y-axis ($1$ through $6$).
|S| = 6 \times 6 = 36 \text{ total outcomes}
An **Event** ($E$ or $A$) is a subset of the sample space ($E \subseteq S$). It represents a specific collection of outcomes satisfying a condition.
Let Event $A$ be: "The sum of the two dice is exactly 7."
Visually, this forms a strict diagonal subset across our grid.
For a single 6-sided die, the sample space is $S = \{1,2,3,4,5,6\}$.
Let Event $B$ = "Roll is Even" = $\{2,4,6\}$
Let Event $C$ = "Roll is greater than 3" = $\{4,5,6\}$
**Deterministic vs Stochastic:** Known physics ($s=ut+\frac{1}{2}gt^2$) vs unknown precise outcomes.
**Sample Space ($\Omega$ or $S$):** The absolute set of all mutually exclusive primitive outcomes.
**Events ($E \subseteq S$):** Subsets that isolate targeted conditions (e.g., Sum = 7).
**Set Operations:** We leverage Unions ($A \cup B$) and Intersections ($A \cap B$) to compute complex overlapping probabilities.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<style>
  body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; user-select: none; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
  canvas { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: #0f172a; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1; const maxSteps = 4;
function advanceToStep(step) { 
    currentStep = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSteps, step));
    time = 0;
    particles = [];
    if(currentStep === 4) {
        for(let i=0; i<100; i++) particles.push(createParticle());
    }
}
let startX, startY, startTime;
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => { if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 15 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 15 && Date.now() - startTime < 350) { if (e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3) { currentStep = Math.max(1, currentStep - 1); } else { currentStep = Math.min(maxSteps, currentStep + 1); } advanceToStep(currentStep); } });

let time = 0;
let particles = [];
function createParticle() {
    return { x: 400, y: 150, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8, vy: Math.random() * 2 };
}

function animate() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(400, 150); ctx.lineTo(400, 500); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(200, 500); ctx.lineTo(600, 500); ctx.stroke();
    
    if (currentStep === 1 || currentStep === 2) {
        let y = 150 + 0.5 * 9.8 * (time * time) * 0.05;
        if (y > 490) y = 490;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(400, y, 10, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    
    if (currentStep === 3) {
        let y = 150 + 0.5 * 9.8 * (time * time) * 0.05;
        let x = 400;
        if (y > 490) {
            y = 490;
            x = 400 + Math.sin(time) * 100; // Random scatter visualization
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 10, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
    
    if (currentStep === 4) {
        particles.forEach(p => {
            p.vy += 0.2;
            p.x += p.vx;
            p.y += p.vy;
            if (p.y > 495) {
                p.y = 495;
                p.vy *= -0.5;
                p.vx *= 0.8;
            }
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        });
    }
    
    time += 0.5;
    
    ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Experiment Models', 20, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    const desc = ['Initial Setup: Fixed Object', 'Deterministic: Exact Physical Path Known', 'Stochastic: Unknown Final Scatter State', 'Distribution of Multiple Random Trials'][currentStep-1];
    ctx.fillText(`Step ${currentStep}/${maxSteps}: ${desc}`, 20, 55);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.font = '14px monospace'; 
    ctx.fillText(`Telemetry: Time T=${time.toFixed(1)} | Model: ${currentStep < 3 ? 'Classical Physics' : 'Probability'}`, 20, 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.font = '12px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Click Left: Prev Step | Click Right: Next Step | [Interaction: Drag/Orbit/Translate]', 20, 580);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<style>
  body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #0f172a; overflow: hidden; font-family: monospace; user-select: none; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; }
  canvas { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; aspect-ratio: 4/3; background: #0f172a; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1; const maxSteps = 4;
function advanceToStep(step) { currentStep = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSteps, step)); }
let startX, startY, startTime;
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => { if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 15 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 15 && Date.now() - startTime < 350) { if (e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3) { currentStep = Math.max(1, currentStep - 1); } else { currentStep = Math.min(maxSteps, currentStep + 1); } advanceToStep(currentStep); } });

function drawNode(x, y, label, color) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 15, 0, Math.PI*2);
    ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText(label, x-4, y+4);
}

function drawLine(x1, y1, x2, y2) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x1, y1); ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke();
}

function animate() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    
    const rootX = 100, rootY = 300;
    drawNode(rootX, rootY, 'S', '#00E5FF');
    
    if (currentStep >= 2) {
        drawLine(rootX, rootY, 250, 200); drawNode(250, 200, 'H', '#10b981');
        drawLine(rootX, rootY, 250, 400); drawNode(250, 400, 'T', '#f43f5e');
    }
    if (currentStep >= 3) {
        drawLine(250, 200, 400, 150); drawNode(400, 150, 'H', '#10b981');
        drawLine(250, 200, 400, 250); drawNode(400, 250, 'T', '#f43f5e');
        drawLine(250, 400, 400, 350); drawNode(400, 350, 'H', '#10b981');
        drawLine(250, 400, 400, 450); drawNode(400, 450, 'T', '#f43f5e');
    }
    if (currentStep >= 4) {
        const ys = [120, 180, 220, 280, 320, 380, 420, 480];
        const labels = ['H','T','H','T','H','T','H','T'];
        const outcomes = ['HHH','HHT','HTH','HTT','THH','THT','TTH','TTT'];
        for(let i=0; i<8; i++) {
            let px = 400, py = (i<4) ? (i<2 ? 150 : 250) : (i<6 ? 350 : 450);
            drawLine(px, py, 550, ys[i]); drawNode(550, ys[i], labels[i], labels[i]==='H'?'#10b981':'#f43f5e');
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.fillText(outcomes[i], 580, ys[i]+4);
        }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Sequential Sample Space (Tree Diagram)', 20, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    const desc = ['Initial State (0 Flips)', 'First Coin Flip (2 Outcomes)', 'Second Coin Flip (4 Outcomes)', 'Third Coin Flip (8 Outcomes, |S| = 8)'][currentStep-1];
    ctx.fillText(`Step ${currentStep}/${maxSteps}: ${desc}`, 20, 55);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.font = '14px monospace'; 
    ctx.fillText(`Telemetry: 2^${currentStep-1} Branches Active`, 20, 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.font = '12px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Click Left: Prev Step | Click Right: Next Step | [Interaction: Drag/Orbit/Translate]', 20, 580);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');

function advanceToStep(step) { currentStep = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSteps, step)); }
let startX, startY, startTime;
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => { if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 15 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 15 && Date.now() - startTime < 350) { if (e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3) { currentStep = Math.max(1, currentStep - 1); } else { currentStep = Math.min(maxSteps, currentStep + 1); } advanceToStep(currentStep); } });

function animate() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    
    const ox = 250, oy = 450, spacing = 50;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox, oy); ctx.lineTo(ox + 350, oy); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(ox, oy); ctx.lineTo(ox, oy - 350); ctx.stroke();
    
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    ctx.fillText('Die 1 (x)', ox + 360, oy + 5);
    ctx.fillText('Die 2 (y)', ox - 30, oy - 360);
    
    for(let i=1; i<=6; i++) {
        ctx.fillText(i, ox + i*spacing - 4, oy + 20);
        ctx.fillText(i, ox - 20, oy - i*spacing + 4);
    }
    
    if (currentStep >= 2) {
        for(let x=1; x<=6; x++) {
            for(let y=1; y<=6; y++) {
                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox + x*spacing, oy - y*spacing, 4, 0, Math.PI*2);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.fill();
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (currentStep >= 3) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)';
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox + 3.5*spacing, oy - 3.5*spacing, 180, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ox + 3.5*spacing, oy - 3.5*spacing, 180, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.fillText('Full Sample Space |S| = 36', 420, 150);
    }
    
    if (currentStep >= 4) {
        for(let x=1; x<=6; x++) {
            for(let y=1; y<=6; y++) {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; ctx.font = '10px monospace';
                ctx.fillText(`(${x},${y})`, ox + x*spacing + 6, oy - y*spacing - 6);
            }
        }
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Multi-Dimensional Grid (2 Dice)', 20, 30);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.font = '14px monospace';
    const desc = ['Coordinate Axes Setup', 'Plotting Primitive Outcomes', 'Defining the Bounding Sample Space', 'Labeling Ordered Pairs (x, y)'][currentStep-1];
    ctx.fillText(`Step ${currentStep}/${maxSteps}: ${desc}`, 20, 55);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.font = '14px monospace'; 
    ctx.fillText(`Telemetry: Total Dimensions = 2 | Outcomes = 36`, 20, 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.font = '12px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Click Left: Prev Step | Click Right: Next Step | [Interaction: Drag/Orbit/Translate]', 20, 580);
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
animate();

function advanceToStep(step) { currentStep = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSteps, step)); }

window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => { if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 15 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 15 && Date.now() - startTime < 350) { if (e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3) { currentStep = Math.max(1, currentStep - 1); } else { currentStep = Math.min(maxSteps, currentStep + 1); } advanceToStep(currentStep); } });

function animate() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    
    const ox = 250, oy = 450, spacing = 50;

        for(let y=1; y<=6; y++) {

<body>
<canvas id="stage" width="800" height="600"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById('stage');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
let currentStep = 1; const maxSteps = 4;
function advanceToStep(step) { currentStep = Math.max(1, Math.min(maxSteps, step)); }
let startX, startY, startTime;
window.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { startX = e.clientX; startY = e.clientY; startTime = Date.now(); });
window.addEventListener('pointerup', e => { if (Math.abs(e.clientX - startX) < 15 && Math.abs(e.clientY - startY) < 15 && Date.now() - startTime < 350) { if (e.clientX < window.innerWidth / 3) { currentStep = Math.max(1, currentStep - 1); } else { currentStep = Math.min(maxSteps, currentStep + 1); } advanceToStep(currentStep); } });

function animate() {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 800, 600);
    
    // Universe S
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.strokeRect(200, 150, 400, 300);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b'; ctx.font = '16px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Sample Space S', 210, 175);
    
    ctx.fillText('1', 250, 400);
    ctx.fillText('3', 550, 400);

    const cx1 = 340, cy1 = 300, r = 90;
    const cx2 = 460, cy2 = 300;
    
    if (currentStep >= 2) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.2)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx1, cy1, r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.fillText('Event B', 280, 240);
        ctx.fillText('2', 300, 300);
    }
    
    if (currentStep >= 3) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2)'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy2, r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#10b981'; ctx.fillText('Event C', 450, 240);
        ctx.fillText('5', 500, 300);
    }
    
    if (currentStep >= 4) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx1, cy1, r, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.clip();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx2, cy2, r, 0, Math.PI*2);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.6)'; ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'; ctx.fillText('4', 400, 280); ctx.fillText('6', 400, 320);
        ctx.fillText('B \u2229 C', 380, 210);
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = '#00E5FF'; ctx.font = '16px monospace'; ctx.fillText('Set Theory: Venn Diagrams', 20, 30);
